_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The analyst's higher-trust read of broken institutional flows and exhaustion signals makes a directional bet here a coin flip in a coil — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until ETF flows sustain above 40 or break below 20 to reveal the true hand.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both place the market in Denial with risk-on undertones, but the analyst sees a distribution top while the narrative sees an accumulation second chance; the analyst's forward call to Disbelief with HOLD is adopted as the more evidence-grounded path
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain above 40 with funding dropping below 0.003% and retail_noise_volume falling below 70 — accumulation resuming allows upgrade to Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows below 20 with exchange_netflow turning positive and VIX breaking 80 — institutional capitulation accelerating forces downgrade toward Anxiety
